create.name: Marysia Miernowska
create.bio:
Marysia Miernowska is a folk herbalist and earth-based spiritual teacher, and calls herself a green witch. She grew up in Poland, where her great-grandmother first showed her the healing plants, and she later trained in the Wise Woman tradition as an apprentice of Sage Maurer at the Gaia School of Healing in California. Hundreds of herbalists have trained through the School of the Sacred Wild, the online school she founded, and she lives in Topanga, California, growing herbs organically for the medicines she makes.

In her teaching, plants are living beings and teachers rather than mere ingredients. Students learn plant spirit communication, sitting quietly with a plant in tea meditation, alongside making infusions, flower essences and simple home remedies, marking the seasons with ritual and journalling, and caring for land through permaculture and regenerative gardening. Her school's ten-month apprenticeship begins each September, and she also leads weekend workshops at Esalen in Big Sur and week-long nature retreats abroad. Her book The Witch's Herbal Apothecary follows the wheel of the year with recipes, prayers and seasonal rituals. Her wider work joins the care of people to the care of the earth, including garden design and earth activism.

books.title: The Witch's Herbal Apothecary: Rituals & Recipes for a Year of Earth Magick and Sacred Medicine Making
books.author: Marysia Miernowska
books.description: A seasonal guide arranged around the wheel of the year, pairing herbal recipes with rituals, prayers and practices for growing, gathering and preparing plants. It sets out a way of living closer to the land through the turning of the seasons.

courses.title: Awakening Spring Within: Somatic Herbalism, Plant Spirit Meditation, and Nature Connection
courses.description: A weekend at Esalen in Big Sur built around tea meditations with spring herbs, time on the land, flower essences and medicine making from the Esalen gardens. Journalling and simple earth rituals mark the turn of the season.

courses.title: Earth, Herbalism & the Sacred Wild Solstice Retreat
courses.description: A week in the Mani peninsula of southern Greece, co-facilitated with Ira Christian, mixing morning practice and movement with plant walks, tea meditations and making teas, tinctures and salves. Evenings close with small ceremonies.
